report_name: AERO-GUARD NEXUS Step 63 System Readiness Snapshot
mode: GET-only; no application records or inventory are modified
disclaimer: Prototype integration evidence only. Not an aircraft maintenance approval or safety certification.

baseline_comparison.primary_metric: MAE in cycles; lower is better
limitations: Not validated for real military aircraft
Simple baselines are comparison references, not state-of-the-art models

data.note: These reports evaluate the saved baseline model; they do not represent the ensemble's independent validation or validation for real aircraft maintenance.
No sensor-specific physical bounds are inferred from training quantiles. C-MAPSS sensor values must not be presented as real aircraft physical measurements without a documented mapping and units.
